    (heta : eta ∈ Icc (-1 : ℝ) 1) :

      (shift F XR) (profilePoint F y eta) ∧
    TerminalEdgeFactor.profileSpeed (normalization F XR) F.data
      (shift F XR) (profilePoint F y eta) ≤ 2 + 2 * F.data.h ∧
